title: Constitution Protection Conference
description: A landmark gathering bringing together citizens, judges, advocates, student leaders, civil society representatives and Citizens Committed to Democracy and Constitutional Values from all 38 districts of Tamil Nadu, united by a shared commitment to the Constitution of India; at a time when constitutional institutions and democratic values face growing challenges. The Constitution belongs to the people and its protection is the collective responsibility of every citizen.
